# Micro SaaS Kits — kits.amosmignery.dev

Public storefront for my digital products. Generated by `build_site.js` in the private
**micro-saas-factory** repo — do not edit `index.html` by hand; regenerate instead.

- **Site:** https://kits.amosmignery.dev (GitHub Pages)
- **Checkout:** Gumroad (Merchant of Record — EU VAT handled)
- **No product files live here.** This repo contains covers and marketing copy only.

## Regenerate
1. From `micro-saas-factory`: `node build_site.js`
2. Copy `showcase-repo/*` into this repo, commit, push.
